notes: Both ὑπό phrases carry their own English *of*, so neither preposition is emptied (rule 36); the articles of those phrases take a bare *the* under rule 19.
Only the article before Ἰησοῦς is unrepresented (rule 23).
ἀνήχθη keeps *up* for the preverb ἀνα- inside its own unit, no expressed preposition standing to answer to it, and heads on *led* rather than the auxiliary (rules 17, 106).
πειρασθῆναι is governed by no preposition, so its *to* is the verb's own helper (rule 61).
